title: Life history strategies and psychopathology: the faster the life strategies, the more symptoms of psychopathology

focal_claim.text: ... those with a faster life strategy report greater levels ... of psychopathology (p. 1.)

reported.statistic: The results revealed significant associations between both life history measures and total psychopathology symptom frequency with faster life strategies associated with more symptoms of psychopathology. (From Table 5: Mini-K life history strategy predicting total psychopathology correlation coefficient = -0.51, p < 0.002)
